description.value: Basil Pasta Bar, established in 2010, is Vancouver's first build-your-own pasta restaurant and a long-running fixture on Davie Street in the West End. Diners choose their own combination of pasta, sauce, and toppings in a casual indoor setting. Takeout and daily delivery are available, making it a practical carb-loading stop for cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver.
